author: TeIq
content: Implemented per architect pre-flight. step_write_new_key_material now dispatches on CustodyMode to four mode-specific helper fns: write_passphrase_sealed_key, write_os_keychain_key, write_cloud_kms_key. RotationContext gained a RotationCustodyParams sum-type carrying the per-mode runtime inputs (passphrase / account / KMS region+alias). CLI binary extended with --account / --kms-region / --kms-alias flags; passphrase comes from POLARIS_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE env (consistent with read path). KMS primitive chosen: CreateKey(KeyUsage=SignVerify, KeySpec=ECC_SECG_P256K1) + UpdateAlias, deviating from the literal 'generate_data_key_pair' in the pre-flight because data-key-pair returns plaintext-encrypted-by-CMK keys which AwsKmsSigner cannot sign with. Per-mode tests: passphrase-sealed in-process roundtrip; os-keychain #[ignore]'d (real OS keychain daemon required); cloud-kms gated by 'kms-integration' feature with localstack-style env gate. All 6 evidence-floor items green: build/clippy/fmt clean, 11 rotation tests pass (1 ignored), 0 Unsupported-passphrase/os_keychain hits, 0 frontend-boundary violations.
